mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hash_key_version) FROM statistics_behavior_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_day=#{day} AND deleted=FALSE

WITH accepted AS ( SELECT event_type, visitor_hash, user_id FROM statistics_behavior_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND occurred_at >= #{begin} AND occurred_at < #{end} AND traffic_quality=1 AND deleted=FALSE ), paid AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) paid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) paid_buyer_count, COALESCE(SUM(i.count),0) paid_item_count, COALESCE(SUM(i.pay_price),0) paid_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NOT NULL THEN i.cost_price*i.count ELSE 0 END),0) paid_known_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NOT NULL AND i.cost_estimated=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exact_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NOT NULL AND i.cost_estimated=TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) estimated_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_rows FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id AND i.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND i.deleted=FALSE WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.deleted=FALSE AND o.pay_status=TRUE AND o.pay_time >=#{begin} AND o.pay_time <#{end} ), refunded AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.refund_price),0) refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.way=20 AND i.cost_price IS NOT NULL THEN i.cost_price*a.count ELSE 0 END),0) returned_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN a.way=20 AND i.cost_price IS NOT NULL AND i.cost_estimated=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exact_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN a.way=20 AND i.cost_price IS NOT NULL AND i.cost_estimated=TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) estimated_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN a.way=20 AND i.cost_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_rows FROM trade_after_sale a JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.id=a.order_item_id AND i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND i.deleted=FALSE WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.deleted=FALSE AND a.refund_time >=#{begin} AND a.refund_time <#{end} ), coverage AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) gap_count FROM statistics_behavior_ingestion_gap WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND day=#{day} AND deleted=FALSE ) SELECT #{day} day, 'USD' currency_code, CASE WHEN coverage.gap_count>0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN (1,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END home_pv, CASE WHEN coverage.gap_count>0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type IN (1,5) THEN visitor_hash END) END home_uv, CASE WHEN coverage.gap_count>0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN event_type=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END product_detail_pv, CASE WHEN coverage.gap_count>0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type=2 THEN visitor_hash END) END product_detail_uv, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN (3,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) add_cart_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type IN (3,7) THEN visitor_hash END) add_cart_user_count, CASE WHEN coverage.gap_count>0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN (4,9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END checkout_start_count, paid.paid_order_count,paid.paid_buyer_count,paid.paid_item_count,paid.paid_revenue,refunded.refund_amount, paid.paid_revenue-refunded.refund_amount net_revenue, paid.paid_known_cost-refunded.returned_cost known_cost_amount, CASE WHEN paid.missing_rows+refunded.missing_rows>0 THEN NULL ELSE paid.paid_known_cost-refunded.returned_cost END cost_amount, CASE WHEN paid.missing_rows+refunded.missing_rows>0 THEN NULL ELSE paid.paid_revenue-refunded.refund_amount-(paid.paid_known_cost-refunded.returned_cost) END gross_profit, paid.exact_rows+refunded.exact_rows exact_cost_item_count,paid.estimated_rows+refunded.estimated_rows estimated_cost_item_count, paid.missing_rows+refunded.missing_rows missing_cost_item_count, CASE WHEN paid.missing_rows+refunded.missing_rows>0 THEN 4 WHEN paid.exact_rows+paid.estimated_rows+refunded.exact_rows+refunded.estimated_rows=0 THEN 5 WHEN paid.exact_rows+refunded.exact_rows>0 AND paid.estimated_rows+refunded.estimated_rows>0 THEN 2 WHEN paid.estimated_rows+refunded.estimated_rows>0 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END profit_data_quality, COUNT(accepted.event_type) accepted_event_count,0 excluded_event_count, CASE WHEN coverage.gap_count>0 OR #{day}=CURRENT_DATE THEN 2 ELSE 1 END traffic_data_status FROM accepted CROSS JOIN paid CROSS JOIN refunded CROSS JOIN coverage GROUP BY coverage.gap_count,paid.paid_order_count,paid.paid_buyer_count,paid.paid_item_count,paid.paid_revenue, paid.paid_known_cost,paid.exact_rows,paid.estimated_rows,paid.missing_rows,refunded.refund_amount, refunded.returned_cost,refunded.exact_rows,refunded.estimated_rows,refunded.missing_rows

WITH e AS ( SELECT spu_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) browse_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type=2 THEN visitor_hash END) browse_user_count, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN (3,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cart_count FROM statistics_behavior_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND occurred_at>=#{begin} AND occurred_at<#{end} AND traffic_quality=1 AND deleted=FALSE AND spu_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY spu_id ), p AS ( SELECT i.spu_id,SUM(i.count) order_pay_count,SUM(i.pay_price) order_pay_price,COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NOT NULL THEN i.cost_price*i.count ELSE 0 END) known_cost_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) missing_cost_item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NOT NULL AND i.cost_estimated=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exact_cost_item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.cost_price IS NOT NULL AND i.cost_estimated=TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) estimated_cost_item_count FROM trade_order o JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id AND i.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND i.deleted=FALSE WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.deleted=FALSE AND o.pay_status=TRUE AND o.pay_time>=#{begin} AND o.pay_time<#{end} GROUP BY i.spu_id ), r AS ( SELECT a.spu_id,SUM(a.refund_price) after_sale_refund_price,SUM(a.count) after_sale_count, SUM(CASE WHEN a.way=20 AND i.cost_price IS NOT NULL THEN i.cost_price*a.count ELSE 0 END) returned_cost FROM trade_after_sale a JOIN trade_order_item i ON i.id=a.order_item_id AND i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND i.deleted=FALSE WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.deleted=FALSE AND a.refund_time>=#{begin} AND a.refund_time<#{end} GROUP BY a.spu_id ), ids AS (SELECT spu_id FROM e UNION SELECT spu_id FROM p UNION SELECT spu_id FROM r) SELECT #{day} time,ids.spu_id,COALESCE(e.browse_count,0) browse_count,COALESCE(e.browse_user_count,0) browse_user_count, COALESCE(e.cart_count,0) cart_count,COALESCE(p.order_count,0) order_count,COALESCE(p.order_pay_count,0) order_pay_count, COALESCE(p.order_pay_price,0) order_pay_price,COALESCE(r.after_sale_count,0) after_sale_count,COALESCE(r.after_sale_refund_price,0) after_sale_refund_price, COALESCE(p.known_cost_amount,0)-COALESCE(r.returned_cost,0) known_cost_amount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.missing_cost_item_count,0)>0 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(p.known_cost_amount,0)-COALESCE(r.returned_cost,0) END cost_amount, COALESCE(p.exact_cost_item_count,0) exact_cost_item_count,COALESCE(p.estimated_cost_item_count,0) estimated_cost_item_count,COALESCE(p.missing_cost_item_count,0) missing_cost_item_count, CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.missing_cost_item_count,0)>0 THEN 4 WHEN COALESCE(p.exact_cost_item_count,0)+COALESCE(p.estimated_cost_item_count,0)=0 THEN 5 WHEN COALESCE(p.exact_cost_item_count,0)>0 AND COALESCE(p.estimated_cost_item_count,0)>0 THEN 2 WHEN COALESCE(p.estimated_cost_item_count,0)>0 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END profit_data_quality, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statistics_behavior_ingestion_gap g WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND g.day=#{day} AND g.deleted=FALSE) OR #{day}=CURRENT_DATE THEN 2 ELSE 1 END traffic_data_status FROM ids LEFT JOIN e ON e.spu_id=ids.spu_id LEFT JOIN p ON p.spu_id=ids.spu_id LEFT JOIN r ON r.spu_id=ids.spu_id
